text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A trial in obese women found that intermittent fasting combined with calorie restriction produced greater weight loss than the food-based version.","cited_pids":["23334c40ad6b#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A 12-week high-protein intermittent-fasting intervention in obese adults was reported as effective for weight loss.","cited_pids":["c74e11d8769a#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-analysis of randomized trials found intermittent energy restriction produced weight loss comparable to continuous restriction.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A pilot study found alternate-day fasting equally effective as daily calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["d5b094e9e37f#7"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A Cochrane review of 22 trials with nearly 2,000 adults found intermittent fasting did not produce significantly more weight loss than standard diet advice.","cited_pids":["5a896703f2e3#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Harvard's Nutrition Source notes that research does not consistently show intermittent fasting is superior to continuous low-calorie diets.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A one-year trial of 100 people found intermittent fasting had no weight loss advantage over daily calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#7"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"One meta-analysis reported a small but significant weight-loss advantage for intermittent fasting.","cited_pids":["f5eeafdf6fc3#1"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Overall, intermittent fasting appears roughly comparable to continuous calorie restriction rather than clearly superior for weight loss.","cited_pids":[]}]}
